'''''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. It is the third miniseries in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] comic series, and it follows the events of the previous miniseries, ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Freedon Nadd Uprising]]''. ''Dark Lords of the Sith'' ran from [[1994]] to [[1995]], and it was followed by the sequel miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War]]''.

[[HighBridge Audio]] released an [[Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi: Dark Lords of the Sith'' audio drama]] of the comic.
